answer: Epoch-Fingerprint Continuity Rule (cross-epoch): each epoch, project an agent’s action vector—timing, counterparties, task mix, value flow—into a fixed reference grove. Compare its Wasserstein distance to the agent’s running centroid; if consistency falls to a new nadir beyond threshold, rewards freeze until recovery. This treats behavioral pigment, not credentials, as continuity. An attacker must sustain coherent costly actions for every sybil across epochs, so N identities cost N× ongoing effort and burst-created sybils are flagged before payout.
